emailauth-desc: Waxay ku xaqiijisaa gelitaannada laga shakiyo iimayl ahaan
emailauth-token-help: Astaanta hal mar la isticmaalo ee 2FA oo loo soo diray iimayl.
emailauth-email-body-intro: $1, waxay u muuqataa inaad isku dayayso inaad ka gasho qalab cusub $2.
emailauth-email-body-warning: Koodhkan ayaa loo baahan yahay si aad u gasho akoonkaaga. Wuxuu dhacayaa $1. Amnigaaga awgiis, ha la wadaagin qof kale.
emailauth-email-body-attack-p1: Iimaylkan waxaa loo diray sababtoo ah qof ayaa isku dayay inuu galo akoonkaaga. Isku dayga gelitaanka wuxuu ku jiray magaca akoonkaaga iyo erayga sirta ah ee saxda ah.
emailauth-email-body-attack-p2: Haddii tani aadan adigu ahayn, waa inaad hadda beddeshaa eraygaaga sirta ah.
emailauth-login-message: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad xaqiijiso gelitaankaaga. Koodh xaqiijin ayaa loo diray iimaylkaaga ($1), fadlan halkan geli koodhkaas.
emailauth-login-help: La xiriir [[{{int:grouppage-sysop}}|maamulayaasha goobta]] haddii aadan mar dambe heli karin iimaylka akoonkaaga. ([[mw:Special:MyLanguage/Help:Extension:EmailAuth|macluumaad dheeraad ah]])
emailauth-accountrecovery-logged-in: Boggan lama heli karo marka la soo galay. Haddii aad u baahan tahay inaad akoon soo ceshato, fadlan marka hore ka bax.
emailauth-accountrecovery-contactemail-l: Iimaylka la xiriirka ee la heli karo
emailauth-accountrecovery-success: Codsigaaga soo celinta akoonka si guul leh ayaa loo gudbiyay. Kooxdayada Aaminaadda & Amniga ayaa dib u eegi doona codsigaaga waxayna kula soo xiriiri doonaan iimaylka aad bixisay.
emailauth-accountrecovery-confirmation-n: Iimayl xaqiijin ah ayaa loo diray iimaylka la xiriirka ee aad bixisay. Si aad u dhammaystirto codsiga soo celinta akoonkaaga, waa inaad gujisaa xiriirka ku jira iimaylka.
emailauth-accountrecovery-confirmation-s: Xaqiiji codsigaaga si aad u soo ceshato akoonkaaga
emailauth-accountrecovery-confirmation-b:
Waxaan helnay codsi lagu soo ceshanayo akoonka lagu magacaabo "$1" ee {{SITENAME}}.

Si aad u sii wadato hawshan, guji xiriirka hoose si aad u xaqiijiso iimaylkaaga. Xiriirku wuxuu dhacayaa $2.

$3

Haddii tani aadan adigu ahayn, si ammaan ah ayaad u iska indhatiri kartaa iimaylkan, wax isbeddel ahna laguma sameyn doono akoonkaaga.
emailauth-accountrecovery-confirmation-r: Xiriirka xaqiijinta wuu dhacay. Xiriir cusub oo xaqiijin ah ayaa loo diray iimaylka la xiriirka ee aad bixisay. Fadlan guji xiriirkan cusub si aad u dhammaystirto codsigaaga soo celinta akoonka.
emailauth-accountrecovery-email-mismatch: Iimaylka aad gelisay isma waafaqsana. Fadlan hubi oo mar kale isku day.
emailauth-accountrecovery-rate-limited: Waxaad gudbisay codsiyo badan oo soo celinta akoonka ah. Fadlan sug ka hor intaadan mar kale isku dayin.
emailauth-accountrecovery-error-generic: Khalad ayaa dhacay intii lagu guda jiray habaynta codsigaaga. Fadlan isku day mar kale mar dambe.
emailauth-accountrecovery-error-invalid-: Macluumaadka aad bixisay lama habayn karin. Fadlan hubi xogta aad gelisay oo mar kale isku day.
emailauth-accountrecovery-error-service-: Adeegga soo celinta akoonka si ku meelgaar ah uma shaqeynayo. Fadlan isku day mar kale mar dambe.
emailauth-accountrecovery-error-badtoken:
Xiriirka xaqiijinta waa khalad.
Waxaa laga yaabaa in xiriirku dhacay.
emailauth-accountrecovery-disabled: Soo celinta akoonka lagama heli karo wiki-kan. Fadlan la xiriir maamulayaasha goobta si aad caawimaad u hesho.
logentry-emailauth-verify-failed: Isku daygii xaqiijinta iimaylka wuu fashilmay
logentry-emailauth-verify-failure: Isku daygii xaqiijinta iimaylka ee $4 wuu fashilmay
logentry-emailauth-verify-success: Isku daygii xaqiijinta iimaylka si guul leh ayuu u dhacay
logentry-emailauth-recovery-submit: Codsi soo celinta akoonka ayaa loo gudbiyay $1
logentry-emailauth-account-recovery-subm: Codsi soo celinta akoonka ayaa loo gudbiyay $4
